decisions.reason: The toilet relocation targets the separate Unit 1 common bathroom and does not change the en-suite bathroom arrangement.
Moving the common-bathroom toilet nearer the drain does not necessarily resolve or change the hinged-door type, opening direction, or sink-collision ambiguity.
The source concerns the Unit 1 common bathroom and does not modify Unit 3 bathroom fixtures or plumbing.
The Unit 1 toilet relocation and fixture-dimension request do not affect the Unit 3 kitchen counter layout.
The source identifies a Unit 1 bathroom change and does not establish any change to the Unit 2 bathroom.
Relocating a toilet within the Unit 1 common bathroom does not necessarily alter corridor or common-entrance space allocation.
The source repeats the request to show sink and shower dimensions, which are already present in the candidate state under fixture_dimension_annotations.
Using a marked wall as the toilet location does not instruct that wall to be preserved, demolished, or constructed.
The bathroom fixture change does not alter open-plan kitchen configuration or cabinetry dimensions.
Relocating a bathroom fixture does not change Unit 1's 2+1 room program.
The source does not change the requirement for one private steel entrance door per dwelling.
The Unit 1 common-bathroom fixture change is unrelated to the Unit 3 balcony-retention policy.
